title: 第5章 未婚妻 想都别想第6章 这个婚还退不退了
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 一阵微风吹拂过两人，他们彼此失了神。
一人低头，手指纠缠一起，搅动的速度加快，指甲都要抠出来。
另一人，惊愕之后，抬起头，看向了天空，流水迷雾阵闪烁晶莹的光芒，那一层迷雾，笼罩了天空，隔绝了外面的窥探，山林之中飘来了一股淡淡的灵药的香味。
茂密的树叶间，有花儿落下，粉红色的花瓣，落在他们的头顶，肩膀上，手里，陈初阳捏住了一朵花瓣，嗅了嗅花香味，而后放开了鲜花，让它随风而去。
尴尬的气氛保持了一刻钟，两人愣是没有说出一句话，陈初阳看着身边少女的害羞和窘迫，道：“你父亲同意吗？”
少女抬起头，笑着摇摇头：“不同意。”
“我父亲可不会同意，他还骂了我母亲一顿。”
“我姐也不会同意的，她可是最疼爱我了，怎么会让我嫁过来？”
她的眼神，小心翼翼扫了一眼陈初阳，想要看看陈初阳的反应。
陈初阳一如既往的平静，和以前一样，小时候这样，长大了，也是如此。
对什么事情都如此平淡，好像没有什么能够让他内心起波澜。
商红雪不由得有些失望，可她知道这是陈初阳的本来面目，也就……没有期待什么。
“我姐想要带我去天心宗，她被天心宗的人看上了，收为弟子，从此以后，她就可以脱离龙蛇城，一飞冲天，我姐不希望我待在龙蛇城，一辈子就这样了。”
“她想要掌控自己的命运，不喜欢被人安排，也不喜欢就这么嫁人了。”
商红尘是个有主见的女人，也是个不甘心待在龙蛇城的人。
她，不可能规规矩矩嫁给陈初阳，成为一个妻子。
陈初阳也算是知道她的为人，毕竟是个天才，骄傲，那是很正常不过。
“你是怎么想的？”
这句话问出口，陈初阳有些后悔，想要收回来，已经来不及了。
他扭开头，看向了其他地方。
商红雪恰巧抬起头注视陈初阳，两人很有默契。
“我不想走。”
商红雪鼓起勇气，说出了内心的那句话。
她，想留下来。
天心宗，不是她想要去的地方。
姐姐是天才，去到天心宗有更好的前程，而她，和姐姐不一样。
她和陈初阳一样，是个普通人，或者说，她连个普通人都不如，身体虚弱，天生虚弱，还没出生的时候落下病根，导致了她的体质比较差，修炼也无法和其他人比，小时候都是在药罐子里泡着长大的，好不容易长大成人，她不喜欢……离开龙蛇城。
她的身体不允许，而且，她想要留下来。
“我喜欢龙蛇城。”
“也喜欢这里。”
眼神，偷偷瞄了一眼陈初阳。
这一幕，自然逃不过陈初阳的双眼。
他听懂了少女的心思，可他。
“你姐可能会逼着你离开，毕竟你的身体，可能去到天心宗就可以治愈了呢？”
她的身体，陈初阳清楚，龙蛇城内出名了难搞，为此，她父亲找了很多个大夫，甚至找了几个炼丹师，都没能解决，天生落下的病根，无法根除。
打小就弱小，瘦削的她，以前还不如一只大公鸡重呢。
好在商红尘保护她，才没让她被人欺负。
“你父亲他们为了你的身体，也会妥协的。”
天心宗，可是大门派，肯定有办法治愈她的。
商红尘非要去天心宗，也有这个想法。
商红雪沉默了。
她自然知道。
可她，真的不想离开。
“我不想去。”
content_en:
A breeze blew across the two of them, and they lost each other's attention.
One person lowered his head, tangled his fingers together, and the stirring speed increased until his nails were pulled out.
The other person, after being shocked, raised his head and looked at the sky. The flowing mist array shone with crystal light. The layer of mist enveloped the sky, blocking out prying eyes from outside. There was a faint scent of elixir floating in the forest.
Among the dense leaves, flowers fell, and pink petals fell on their heads, shoulders, and hands. Chen Chuyang pinched a petal, smelled the fragrance of the flower, and then let go of the flower, letting it go with the wind.
The awkward atmosphere lasted for a quarter of an hour. The two of them didn't say a word. Chen Chuyang looked at the shyness and embarrassment of the girl next to him and said, "Does your father agree?"
The girl raised her head, smiled and shook her head: "I disagree."
"My father would not agree. He even scolded my mother."
"My sister won't agree either. She loves me the most. How could she let me marry her?"
Her eyes carefully glanced at Chen Chuyang, wanting to see Chen Chuyang's reaction.
Chen Chuyang was as calm as ever, just like before. He was like this when he was a child, and he was like this when he grew up.
He was so calm about everything, as if nothing could make his heart turbulent.
Shang Hongxue couldn't help but feel a little disappointed, but she knew that this was Chen Chuyang's true face, so... she didn't expect anything.
"My sister wants to take me to Tianxin Sect. She was attracted by the people of Tianxin Sect and accepted as a disciple. From then on, she can leave Dragon Snake City and fly into the sky. My sister doesn't want me to stay in Dragon Snake City and stay like this for the rest of my life."
"She wants to control her own destiny. She doesn't like to be arranged by others, and she doesn't like to just get married."
Shang Hongchen is an independent woman and a person who is not willing to stay in Dragon Snake City.
It was impossible for her to marry Chen Chuyang in a proper manner and become a wife.
Chen Chuyang also knew who she was. After all, she was a genius. It was normal to be proud.
"What do you think?"
Chen Chuyang regretted these words and wanted to take them back, but it was already too late.
He turned his head and looked elsewhere.
Shang Hongxue happened to raise his head and look at Chen Chuyang. The two had a tacit understanding.
"I don't want to leave."
Shang Hongxue mustered up the courage to say what was in her heart.
She wants to stay.
Tianxin Sect is not the place she wants to go.
My sister is a genius and will have a better future if she goes to Tianxin Sect, but she is different from her sister.
Like Chen Chuyang, she is an ordinary person, or in other words, she is not even as good as an ordinary person. Her body is weak and she was born weak. The root of the disease was caused when she was not born, which resulted in her poor constitution and her cultivation cannot be compared with others. She grew up soaking in medicine jars when she was a child. It was not easy for her to grow into an adult. She didn't like...leaving Dragon Snake City.
Her body wouldn't allow it, and besides, she wanted to stay.
"I like Dragon Snake City."
"I like it here too."
His eyes secretly glanced at Chen Chuyang.
This scene naturally cannot escape Chen Chuyang's eyes.
He understood the girl's thoughts, but he.
"Your sister may force you to leave. After all, your body may be cured by going to Tianxin Sect?"
Chen Chuyang knew that her body was notoriously difficult to deal with in Dragon Snake City. For this reason, her father found many doctors and even several alchemists, but they could not solve it. The root cause of the disease could not be eradicated.
She has been weak and skinny since she was a child. She used to be as heavy as a big rooster.
Fortunately, Shang Hongchen protected her and prevented her from being bullied.
"Your father and others will also compromise for your health."
Tianxin Sect is a large sect, so there must be a way to cure her.
Shang Hongchen insisted on going to Tianxin Sect, and he also had this idea.
Shang Hongxue was silent.
Of course she knows.
But she really didn't want to leave.
"I don't want to go."
title_en: Chapter 5: Fiancée, don’t even think about it Chapter 6: Can I cancel this marriage?
